affectedRuntimeRoots: continuous recovery Linux evidence acceptance workflow

applicability.rationale: The 6d public report contains null PASS transport observations in all three snapshots and strict LOSS observations; the base reader incorrectly required LOSS observations for PASS.

confidence.rationale: Exact patch identity, manifest, both after-images, Go producer behavior, reader call graph, focused mutants, and the immutable 6d public originals were independently inspected and replayed.

evidencePlan.action: Integrate the exact two-path patch, then run the new-head Linux Go/gofmt continuous HTTPS job and fresh independent source/privacy verification without modifying reports or manifests.
evidencePlan.question: Does the exact integrated head reproduce the corrected observations and pass every unchanged gate?

impact.rationale: The patch changes an independent diagnostic acceptance contract. A defect could falsely accept or reject continuous recovery evidence, but it does not alter the Go adapter, production behavior, persistence, or credentials.

importantCallers: continuous recovery source and privacy acceptance chain

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A fabricated PASS claims bodyBytes zero, EOF true, or close success true even though the adapter returned the response without observing those facts.
materialBoundaries.invariant: A PASS step must report unknown body, EOF, and close observations as null while retaining PASS, PASSTHROUGH, status 204, one round trip, injected false, and no failure.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The reader requires all three values to be None only for step two, and independent mutants for each fabricated value are rejected.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: A LOSS step supplies null, false, boolean zero, or floating-point zero aliases.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Each LOSS step must retain bodyBytes as integer zero and EOF/close as exact true values.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: integer uses type(value) is int with range zero-to-zero, EOF and close use identity with True, and focused mutants reject all listed aliases.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: The patch accepts fewer than 31 originals, changes status/head/recovery relationships, or bypasses final source/privacy checks.
materialBoundaries.invariant: The transport correction must not weaken HTTP count/body, lifecycle, cleanup, source, privacy, or fence gates.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The immutable diff changes only the three transport observation predicates; validate_http, lifecycle relationships, closed ports, manifests, commands, source tags, inventories, and fences are byte-unchanged.

materialBoundaries.counterexample: The 6d logic replay is mislabeled as proof that a new source head compiled, ran 31 requests, and passed source/privacy gates.
materialBoundaries.invariant: Only a clean new-head Linux run with exact source binding and fresh independent verification can establish overall acceptance.
materialBoundaries.legitimateControl: The receipt labels the replay DIAGNOSTIC_READER_LOGIC_REPLAY_NOT_EXACT_HEAD_ACCEPTANCE and leaves new-head Go, gofmt, 31-request, source, and fresh checks pending.
materialBoundaries.runtimeRoot: continuous recovery Linux and fresh checker jobs

protectiveFactors: PASS accepts only three exact null observations
LOSS retains strict int zero and exact true observations
Step action, state, status, counters, injection, and failure code remain strict
All unrelated report and source/privacy gates are unchanged
Fabricated PASS and weakened LOSS variants are rejected

recoverability.rationale: The two-path reader-and-test patch has no data migration or runtime state effect and can be reverted atomically.

regressionLikelihood.rationale: The split matches the unchanged Go producer semantics: PASS returns the response without reading or closing it, while LOSS records exact consumption and close observations. Strict positive and negative model coverage and an original-report replay support the change.

regressionProtection.rationale: The focused reader model and diagnostic replay passed, and the supplied receipt reports all 300 Python tests passed, but no exact committed-head Linux Go, gofmt, new 31-request run, source binding, or fresh independent acceptance exists.

riskDrivers: Reader acceptance controls whether a security-sensitive recovery experiment is trusted
New exact-head Linux execution and source binding are unavailable
Diagnostic replay uses immutable 6d originals rather than a new-head run

statusQuoRisk.rationale: Without the patch, authentic public evidence is rejected even though its PASS nulls accurately represent an unread and unclosed passthrough response.

unknowns.summary: The exact integrated new head has not run Linux Go/gofmt, the 31-request experiment, source binding, or fresh independent acceptance.
